subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split this into a narrow heartbeat-session precedence fix first, leaving Telegram DM default-to-main behavior unchanged unless a separate compatibility decision approves changing it?
rationale: Source inspection supports the heartbeat precedence bug, but the broader requested Telegram DM isolation would change documented default behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win over wake/origin session keys and add focused regression coverage without changing Telegram `session.dmScope` defaults.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs away from main-session sharing by default, with docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof for existing shared-context users.

options.title: Defer to per-session heartbeat design
options.body: Leave this issue open behind the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling direction and avoid piecemeal routing changes for now.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win over wake/origin session keys and add focused regression coverage without changing Telegram `session.dmScope` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The unified heartbeat runner history and recent heartbeat scheduling work make this the clearest available owner for the heartbeat/product split decision.
